title: Disjointness of three coordinate blocks
statement: Let $d\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $i,j\in\{0,1,2\}$ be distinct. The coordinate blocks in the $(d+1)$st recursive three-way construction associated with $i$ and $j$ are disjoint.
